answer: A raven draws random pairs per epoch. Each pair co-signs a receipt: one surveys a yarrow bed, the other reads an ember kiln, and both keys sign the receipt. Auditors replay the log; a receipt signed twice by one key, or a rented partner's signature, burns both 70-credit bonds. 1,000 fakes cost 35,000 in fees plus 70,000 locked, and about 910 pair with honest agents who refuse, burning 63,700 more, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 35 once.
